requirements.title: The listed procedure categories are elemental procedures
requirements.definition: An elemental procedure is an elemental intrinsic procedure, an intrinsic-module module procedure specified elemental, a procedure defined by an elemental subprogram, or a type-bound procedure bound to an elemental procedure.

pending.elemental-intrinsic-is-elemental: PENDING source-use plan: intrinsic ABS is applied to integer array [-2,3] and returns exact [2,3], with intrinsic-specific obligations credited to clause 16.
pending.intrinsic-module-specified-elemental-is-: PENDING source-use plan: use an intrinsic-module procedure specified ELEMENTAL by its catalogue on a rank-one integer array and observe exact elementwise results owned by that procedure.
pending.elemental-subprogram-defines-elemental-p: PENDING positive source plan: ELEMENTAL integer function inc(n) maps array [4,6] to exact [5,7] from result sentinel [-1,-1].
pending.type-bound-to-elemental-is-elemental: PENDING source-use plan: type-bound procedure bound to ELEMENTAL module function returns exact component+1 for an array of two elements, expecting exact [11,21].

requirements.title: Elemental references with array arguments require array OUT/INOUT actuals, conformability, and whole-reference association

accounting.rationale: Definition, scalar-dummy restriction, and array-actual permission are split into fine units.
Defines the categories that are elemental procedures.
Records the scalar-dummy restriction; required diagnostics are credited to C15118.
Admits array actual arguments for elemental procedures.
Restricts ELEMENTAL specification for dummy procedures and procedure pointers.
Elemental-prefix definition, purity classification, and constraint introduction are split.

Introduces the numbered constraints that follow; no independent semantic obligation beyond those constraints.
